entities.summary: Stefan Doernberg was a German writer, secondary school teacher and Researcher of Contemporary History as well as the final director of International Relations Institute for the Academy of the State and Jurisprudence for the German Democratic Republic. He was the East German ambassador to Finland from 1981 to 1987.
